Rosamund Achebe-Whitlock 11/06/2026 3:12 PM
Hi, my mom had her Neulasta on-body injector put on yesterday. She has bone pain in her hips. Is that normal? You can reach me at 555-0147. – Cordelia (daughter)
Infusion Nursing Pool 11/06/2026 4:05 PM
Hi Cordelia, bone pain is common after pegfilgrastim. Loratadine 10 mg daily can help. Call right away for temperature above 100.4 F.
Rosamund Achebe-Whitlock 11/07/2026 8:20 AM
Thank you. Her ANC from Thursday was 0.9 - should she still come Monday? Cordelia Whitlock, proxy
